fixes.description: Changed notification service image from tikiclone-auth:latest to tikiclone-notification:latest. Replaced auth-specific env vars (AUTH_HTTP_PORT, MYSQL_DATABASE=tiki_auth, JWT_ACCESS_SECRET) with notification-appropriate vars (NOTIFICATION_HTTP_PORT, MYSQL_DATABASE=tiki_notification, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT).
Replaced uniform 500ms timeout with per-service timeouts: payment=3s, order=2s, catalog/cart/search/inventory/recommendation=1s, auth=500ms, default=1s.
Replaced debug exporter with real exporters: otlp exporter pointing to otel-collector:4317 for traces, prometheusremotewrite exporter pointing to prometheus:9090 for metrics.
Fixed NewPaymentService to require kafkaProducer and fraudDetector as explicit parameters (no nil defaults). Added nil checks that panic if either is nil. Added imports for kafka and fraud packages.
Removed the 'change-me-in-production' conditional check. JWT auth middleware is now always enforced when AccessSecret is non-empty on both order and payment services.

Aligned all gateway upstream default addresses with docker-stack.yml service names: identity-auth:8080, category:8088, cart:8082, order:8084, inventory:8086, payment:8083, search:8088, recommendation:8091, delivery:8092.

Added 4 missing service placeholder definitions to root docker-stack.yml: inventory (tikiclone-inventory:latest:8086), payment (tikiclone-payment:latest:8083), recommendation (tikiclone-recommendation:latest:8091), delivery (tikiclone-delivery:latest:8092). All configured with proper Redis, Kafka, MySQL, healthcheck, and resource limits.
Changed checkout route target from 'order' to 'checkout' so /api/v1/checkout routes to the checkout service (port 8085) instead of the order service.

Standardized auth middleware public path matching to use only strings.HasPrefix (prefix matching) instead of mixing exact match and prefix match. This ensures consistent behavior for all sub-paths of public endpoints.
